buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) Text Clause(s) Scope of Work i) Preparation, submission & obtaining approval of Modification of Mining Plan for Iron Ores in respect o f Kiriburu-Meghahatuburu Mining Lease (2897.499 Ha.), under district Singhbhum West, Jharkhand for the period of 2027-28 to 2029-30 ii) Successful bidder shall carry out site inspection of Kiriburu-Meghahatuburu Iron Ore Mines (2897.499 Ha.) and collection of relevant data for preparation of mining plan. iii) The successful bidder shall prepare the Surface Plan by conducting a detailed topographical survey u sing the latest surveying techniques, such as Total Station/ Drone/ DGPS, or equivalent, and with mar king all existing surface features in accordance with the guidelines prescribed under Rule 32 of MCDR, 2017. iv) SAIL shall provide all relevant data like available geological data, borehole logs, assay results, sectio ns, plans from existing mine records. Tenderer shall ensure for updating of Surface Geological plan wi th consultation with mine geologists based on latest topographic survey carried out by Tenderer, as p er guidelines (refer : Rule 32 of MCDR’17). The successful bidder shall also collect and incorporate all exploration data generated during the execution period of the work (FY 2025-26 & 2026–27) into all r elevant plans, sections, reports, and other documents. v) SAIL shall provide all newly generated exploration data, which shall be incorporated by the successf ul bidder for the estimation of geological resources and reserves, as well as mineable reserves and res ources, in accordance with the guidelines of the United Nations Framework Classification (UNFC). vi) Geological sections (transverse & longitudinal) of all working/non-working blocks of the lease shall be updated for cross sectional reserve/ resource estimation as per guidelines of United Nations Framewo rk Classification (UNFC). Based on the new exploration data geological cross sections and plan should be updated accordingly, and mining method and other relevant activities shall be incorporated. vii) Assessment of existing pits, dumps, subgrade stacks, roads, OHP, crushing/screening plant, Electrical setups, infrastructure, plantation and any other infrastructure and development during the time perio d of work (FY 2026-27) and will incorporate the data in all relevant documents.

viii) Successful bidder shall be Considered for preparation of Mod Mining Plan the total ROM capacity of 16 MTPA of KIOM &MIOM as per EC/Statutory Documents (ROM Plan year wise may intimated by SAIL dur ing preparation). Area wise distribution of excavation of ROM, Waste and mineral rejects, sub-grade s tock evacuation to be planned in consultation with SAIL Officials. Waste dump yard shall be proposed with respect to the last approved the Review of Mining Plan (after identification of barren/ non- mineralized areas and mined out areas) after discussion with executing authority. ix) All above planning shall be done for three years of excavation, exploration, stacking of sub-grade, so rting of minerals & mineral rejects, waste dump and PMCP shall be done in view of last approved mini ng plan and other relevant documents of KIOM-MIOM lease. x) Provision of Tailings fines (the quantity will be communicated later on) for: i. Sale in open market, ii. Despatch to SAIL Steel Plants for captive use. iii. For pellet conversion after beneficiation through external agency for use at SAIL Steel Plants The distribution of i, ii & iii will be informed in due course. xi) If it is felt that the plan is to be extended beyond broken area than the same is to be finalized afte r discussion with executing authority. xii) In Plant flow sheet, mobile Crusher & screening units and wet circuit (if required) up to tailing pond need to be incorporated and shall be provided by SAIL. xiii) The successful tenderer (henceforth will be referred as ‘successful bidder’) will prepare Review of M ining plan abiding by MCR’16, MCDR’17 and all other relevant Acts and Rules in respect of submissio n with IBM. xiv) Prior to commencement for preparation of the document, the successful bidder (QP along with Tech nical Help) shall thoroughly visit the Kiriburu-Meghahatuburu Mining Lease, detailed meeting will be held with mines officials for understanding/clearing of doubts/specific requirement of mine. The succ essful bidder shall also collect required data/information /Plan from mines. xv) Before uploading of final draft document on MPAS portal, the documents shall be shared for review and approval of executing authority. The same shall be applicable during submission of Final Docum ent after compliance of all scrutiny comments raised by IBM after inspection. xvi) The successful bidder require visiting KIOM-MIOM, IBM Offices (Ranchi, Kolkata & Nagpur) during pr eparation/approval of the Review of Mining Plan, the expenditure incurred for transit, lodging and foo ding shall be borne by the successful bidder w.r.t. Review of Modification of Mining Plan in respect of Kiriburu-Meghahatuburu Iron Ore Mines. xvii) The successful bidder shall submit three (03) hard-bound draft sets of the Modification of Mining Pla n along with the Progressive Mine Closure Plan (PMCP) for the plan period 2027–28 to 2029–30, inclu ding all text, plans, annexures, and related documents. The all technical representative from the bid der's side, along with the bidder's technical representative, shall remain present during the inspectio n of the mining lease by the officials of the Indian Bureau of Mines (IBM) and provide all necessary te chnical assistance and clarifications. xviii) Successful bidder has to ensure compliance of all scrutiny comments received from IBM, Ranchi wit hin stipulated time and getting approval of review of Mining Plan from IBM, Ranchi within scheduled time. xix) If the draft Review of Modification of Mining Plan for the Kiriburu–Meghahatuburu Mining Lease is rej ected by the competent authority, the successful bidder shall re-carry out the complete work, includi ng preparation, submission, and obtaining approval of the revised Mining Plan, at no additional cost t o the Employer. Any extension of the contract period due to such rework shall be subject to Liquidat ed Damages (LD) if the delay is attributable to the successful bidder. xx) In addition to all, the successful bidder shall share with SAIL all back-calculation data sheets, suppo rting calculations, and maps used for the estimation and derivation of Resources and Reserves. xxi) The successful bidder shall submit three nos. approved copies (03 nos. sets hard bound plan, text, annexures and others) of Review of Mining Plan for Plan Period 2027-28 to 2029-30 and soft copies o f same in Pen Drive/DVD (Plates in PDF, Autocad (.dwg), GIS (KML & Shape file) Format and Text in M S-Word Format and Annexures in PDF Format of Approved Review of Modification of Mining Plan of Ki riburu-Meghahatuburu Mining Lease, CMLO, CMLO, SAIL for Plan Period 2027-28 to 2029-30. xxii) It will be the whole responsibility of the Successful bidder to get the approval of Modification of Mini ng for Plan period (2027-28 to 2029-30) of Kiriburu - Meghahatuburu Iron Ore Mines lease area of 28 97.499 Ha from the Indian Bureau of Mines (IBM), Regional Office, Ranchi.

xxiii) All statutory fees etc. to be paid with the application, if any, to the Indian Bureau of Mines, will be b orne by SAIL and all related liaison work with IBM Ranchi or Kolkata shall be done by Successful bidd er behalf of SAIL Mines. 2.
